description: Local-first personal AI identity and memory for MCP-compatible coding tools — lessons, decisions, playbooks, and project context you can see, edit, and override.

tool_signatures.name: add_decision
tool_signatures.description: 记录单条关键决策（用户明确选了某个方案）。 / Record one key decision when the user explicitly chose an option.

tool_signatures.name: add_lesson
tool_signatures.description: 记录单条经验教训（你已经知道要记什么）。 / Record one lesson learned when you already know what to save.

tool_signatures.name: add_playbook
tool_signatures.description: 记录操作手册（Playbook）— 结构化的多步骤流程。 / Record an operational playbook — a structured multi-step procedure.

tool_signatures.name: archive_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 按 ID 归档 lesson 或 decision（自动识别类型）。 / Archive a lesson or decision by ID, automatically detecting the item type.

tool_signatures.name: check_anchors
tool_signatures.description: Owner-only: revalidate anchor-backed freshness provenance for one repository.

tool_signatures.name: confirm_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: Owner-only: explicitly stamp a knowledge item with human/test/anchor freshness provenance.

tool_signatures.name: doctor
tool_signatures.description: 记忆系统自诊断。 / Memory system self-diagnosis.

tool_signatures.name: explore_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 探索知识关联：相连条目、相似条目或全库合并建议。 / Explore knowledge links: related items, similar items, or merge candidates across the library.

tool_signatures.name: export_engram
tool_signatures.description: 导出 Engram 数据：单文件备份或 OpenClaw 兼容格式。 / Export Engram data: a single-file backup, or the OpenClaw-compatible format.

tool_signatures.name: export_feedback_report
tool_signatures.description: 导出匿名内测反馈报告。 / Export anonymous beta feedback report.

tool_signatures.name: export_knowledge_report
tool_signatures.description: 导出完整 Markdown 知识报告并返回内容。 / Export a full Markdown knowledge report and return its content.

tool_signatures.name: extract_session_insights
tool_signatures.description: 从会话摘要中批量自动提取经验教训和决策（你不需要自己分类）。 / Automatically extract lessons and decisions from a session summary without manually classifying them.

tool_signatures.name: find_tool
tool_signatures.description: 搜索已注册的本地工具/程序。 / Search for registered local tools and programs.

tool_signatures.name: get_audit_log
tool_signatures.description: 获取最近的审计日志条目。 / Get recent audit log entries.

tool_signatures.name: get_daily_log
tool_signatures.description: 读取项目的每日日志（人类可读的会话时间线）。 / Read a project's daily log (human-readable session timeline).

tool_signatures.name: get_decisions
tool_signatures.description: 按时间列出关键决策；也可还原决策链或某个问题的修订历史。 / List the user's key decisions by time; can also reconstruct a decision thread or a question's revision history.

tool_signatures.name: get_identity_card
tool_signatures.description: 导出用户的可携带 AI 身份卡（Markdown 格式）。 / Export the user's portable AI identity card as Markdown.

tool_signatures.name: get_identity_facets
tool_signatures.description: 按切面读取用户身份信息（画像/偏好/信任边界/工作风格/质量标准/领域图谱）。 / Read user identity facets: profile, preferences, trust boundaries, work style, quality standards, and the domain map.

tool_signatures.name: get_knowledge_history
tool_signatures.description: 查看一个知识条目（lesson/decision/playbook）的修订历史。 / Return the revision history (superseded snapshots) of one knowledge item.

tool_signatures.name: get_knowledge_inheritance
tool_signatures.description: 为新项目或任务生成可继承知识包。 / Build a knowledge inheritance pack for a new project or task.

tool_signatures.name: get_knowledge_overview
tool_signatures.description: 获取统一的知识概览：摘要、健康报告和过期知识。 / Get a unified knowledge overview: digest, health report, and stale items.

tool_signatures.name: get_lessons
tool_signatures.description: 获取用户从过去项目中学到的经验教训。 / Get lessons the user learned from past projects.

tool_signatures.name: get_permission_profile
tool_signatures.description: 查看当前所有调用者的权限全景：谁有什么信任级别、能看到什么。 / View the permission landscape: who has what trust level and what they can access.

tool_signatures.name: get_playbooks
tool_signatures.description: Playbook 统一读取入口：列表 / 单条 / 最近使用 / 管理视图。 / Unified Playbook reader: list, single item, recently used, or management view.

tool_signatures.name: get_project_context
tool_signatures.description: 读取特定项目的知识快照（项目级，只含该项目的历史）。 / Read the knowledge snapshot for a specific project, containing only that project's history.

tool_signatures.name: get_recall
tool_signatures.description: 获取结构化 Recall Surface v1 载荷。 / Get a structured Recall Surface v1 payload.

tool_signatures.name: get_recent_context
tool_signatures.description: 找回最近的 AI 对话上下文。 / Retrieve the most recent AI conversation context.

tool_signatures.name: get_relevant_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 按项目路径自动推荐最相关的经验教训（无需搜索词）。 / Automatically recommend the most relevant lessons for a project path, without search keywords.

tool_signatures.name: get_resume_brief
tool_signatures.description: 跨会话/跨工具接续简报（v3.30 新增）。 / Cross-session, cross-tool resume brief.

tool_signatures.name: get_stale_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 列出超过指定天数未复习的知识条目。 / List knowledge items not reviewed for more than the specified number of days.

tool_signatures.name: get_user_context
tool_signatures.description: 获取用户的个性化上下文（冷启动，分层延迟可控）。 / Get tiered cold-start user context with latency control.

tool_signatures.name: get_wrap_up_session_status
tool_signatures.description: 读取 wrap_up_session 的阶段状态。 / Read metadata-only stage status for a wrap_up_session operation.

tool_signatures.name: import_engram
tool_signatures.description: 导入 Engram 数据：从备份文件或 OpenClaw 兼容文件。 / Import Engram data: from a backup file, or from OpenClaw-compatible files.

tool_signatures.name: ingest_notes
tool_signatures.description: 从自由文本笔记中提取经验教训和关键决策并写入知识库。 / Extract lessons and key decisions from free-form notes and save them to the knowledge base.

tool_signatures.name: list_agent_sessions
tool_signatures.description: 列出可用的 AI 对话上下文记录（仅元数据）。 / List available AI context sessions (metadata only).

tool_signatures.name: list_projects
tool_signatures.description: 列出用户参与过的所有项目及基本信息。 / List all projects the user has worked on with basic metadata.

tool_signatures.name: list_tools
tool_signatures.description: 列出所有已注册的本地工具/程序。 / List all registered local tools and programs.

tool_signatures.name: manage_caller_trust
tool_signatures.description: 调用者信任统一入口：授予 / 修改 / 撤销某个 AI 工具的信任级别。 / Unified caller-trust management: grant, change, or revoke an AI tool's trust level.

tool_signatures.name: manage_playbook
tool_signatures.description: Playbook 统一管理入口：更新 / 归档 / 删除 / 恢复。 / Unified Playbook management: update, archive, delete, restore.

tool_signatures.name: manage_relation
tool_signatures.description: 知识关系统一入口：建立或移除条目间关联（无类型双向 / 有类型有向）。 / Unified knowledge relations: create or remove links between items (untyped bidirectional, or typed directed).

tool_signatures.name: memory_store
tool_signatures.description: 统一知识写入入口 — 根据 kind 自动路由到 add_lesson / add_decision / add_playbook。

tool_signatures.name: merge_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 将次要知识条目合并进主知识条目。 / Merge a secondary knowledge item into a primary knowledge item.

tool_signatures.name: onboard_accept
tool_signatures.description: Owner-only: accept an onboard candidate and stamp anchor provenance.

tool_signatures.name: onboard_repo
tool_signatures.description: Owner-only: scan a repo and create staging repo-fact candidates.

tool_signatures.name: playbook_execution
tool_signatures.description: Playbook 执行统一入口：准备计划 / 更新步骤 / 查看状态。 / Unified Playbook execution: prepare a plan, update a step, or check status.

tool_signatures.name: preview_context_governance
tool_signatures.description: Build a local context-governance preview; proposal-only, no apply.

tool_signatures.name: read_web_content
tool_signatures.description: 读取网页、视频或文章的文本内容。 / Read text content from a web page, video, or article.

tool_signatures.name: refresh_quick_context
tool_signatures.description: 刷新本地 `quick_context.md` 快照（跨工具 / 离线场景的快速通路）。 / Refresh the local quick_context.md snapshot (cross-tool / offline fast path).

tool_signatures.name: register_tool
tool_signatures.description: 注册本地工具/程序到环境图谱（已存在则更新）。 / Register a local tool or program in the environment registry; updates if it already exists.

tool_signatures.name: request_outline_review
tool_signatures.description: 生成交互式知识审查 HTML 页面，用户可在浏览器中逐条保留或归档知识。 / Generate an interactive knowledge review HTML page where the user can retain or archive items.

tool_signatures.name: review_staging
tool_signatures.description: 知识评审统一入口：列队列 / 批量审批 / 单条复习 / 执行审查结果。 / Unified knowledge review: list the staging queue, batch-approve, refresh one item, or apply review-page results.

tool_signatures.name: save_agent_context
tool_signatures.description: 自动保存 AI 对话上下文检查点。 / Auto-save an AI conversation context checkpoint.

tool_signatures.name: save_project_snapshot
tool_signatures.description: 写入或更新项目的知识快照（写操作，不是读取）。 / Write or update a project's knowledge snapshot; this is a write operation, not a read.

tool_signatures.name: search_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 搜索知识库（lessons/decisions/playbooks）。 / Search lessons, decisions, and playbooks by keyword.

tool_signatures.name: start_project
tool_signatures.description: 新项目一键启动：继承跨项目经验并建立项目档案。 / Start a new project in one step: inherit cross-project knowledge and create a project record.

tool_signatures.name: update_identity
tool_signatures.description: 更新一个身份字段。 / Update one identity field.

tool_signatures.name: update_knowledge
tool_signatures.description: 按 ID 更新 lesson、decision 或 playbook（自动识别类型）。 / Update a lesson, decision, or playbook by ID, automatically detecting the item type.

tool_signatures.name: user_portrait
tool_signatures.description: 用户写照统一入口：查看 / 对比 / 保存快照。 / Unified user portrait: view, compare, or snapshot.

tool_signatures.name: wrap_up_session
tool_signatures.description: 会话结束一键收尾：自动提取知识、操作流程并保存项目快照。 / Wrap up a session in one step: extract knowledge, detect playbooks, and save a project snapshot.
